title: Operators and Decisions
summary: Learn how your program can make decisions based on conditions.

steps.title: Operators
steps.markdownContent: You can use arithmetic operators like `+`, `-`, `*`, and `/` to calculate values. Comparison operators like `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` compare values and result in `true` or `false`.

steps.title: Making Decisions with If
steps.markdownContent: An `if` statement lets your code make decisions: `if (condition) { do this; }`. It only runs the block if the condition is true.

steps.title: If / Else
steps.markdownContent: Use `else` to specify what happens when the condition is false.

steps.title: Decision Simulator
steps.markdownContent: Press the virtual button and watch the if/else branch execute.

steps.title: Predict Output
steps.markdownContent: Predict the output of this if/else chain.

steps.title: Knowledge Check
steps.markdownContent: Test what you learned about operators and decisions.

questions.question: Which operator checks if two values are equal?
questions.explanation: == compares values, while = assigns a value.

questions.question: What does an `if` statement do?
options: Executes code only if a condition is true
questions.explanation: If statements create decision branches based on conditions.

questions.question: When does the `else` block run?
options: When the if condition is true
When the if condition is false
questions.explanation: Else provides a fallback when the initial condition is not met.
